persona_and_vision: E1: Top 1% Creative Designer. Organic & Earthy archetype tailored for ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) compliance. Rejects typical 'SaaS Blue' in favor of grounded, trust-building aesthetics.

rules.anti_patterns: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. NEVER use text-7xl+ for dashboards.

colors.rules: No pure black or pure white without purpose. No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with crisp 1px borders for UI surfaces.

layout_and_spacing.onboarding_launchpad: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Active step (Facility Info) takes col-span-12 or col-span-8 with prominent CTA. Future steps (Assessments, Tasks) take col-span-4 or stack elegantly.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped p-2/p-4 unless deep inside a component.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Left-align CTAs relative to container.

onboarding_checklist.style: Not a rigid wizard. A launchpad. Cards with crisp 1px borders.
onboarding_checklist.active_step: Surface: White. Border: 2px solid #1A3626. Features the primary 'Continue Setup' CTA.
onboarding_checklist.completed_step: Surface: Stone-50 (dimmed). Shows a green checkmark or 'Completed' badge.
onboarding_checklist.future_step: Surface: White. Border: 1px solid Stone-200. No primary CTA until prerequisites are met.

unavailable_modules.style: De-emphasize visually to avoid distracting from core tasks.
unavailable_modules.context: Applies to Social, Environment, Energy, Water modules if the supplier shouldn't access them yet.

headers_and_nav.style: Crystal Glassmorphism if floating (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200), OR Solid White with crisp bottom border.
headers_and_nav.anti_pattern: NEVER use a fully transparent header over content.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A3626] text-white hover:bg-[#132A1C] transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1A3626] text-[#1A3626] hover:bg-stone-100 transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have hover states (e.g., hover:-translate-y-0.5, hover:shadow-md).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out. DO NOT use generic 'transition: all' in CSS files if it breaks transforms.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text against backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="onboarding-facility-setup-btn"`).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Use .js files (JSX), NOT .tsx files. Do not write TypeScript.
DO NOT create generic centered layouts (e.g., .App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Ensure unavailable modules (Energy, Water, etc.) are visually muted (opacity-50, grayscale) to establish hierarchy.
Do not redesign existing facility or task modules; focus purely on the launchpad/entry-point experience.
